content.text: I’ll trace the search indexing, lifecycle updates, and workspace rebuild paths, then make the smallest code changes that enforce the live-project/issue/comment rule consistently.

The index writers now reject archived or orphaned content, while search queries also validate each indexed row against its current project/issue/comment state so stale rows cannot affect either results or totals. I’m finishing the rebuild path so it clears only the requested workspace and walks every page of content.
